Name: BinocularFindingVS
Title: Binocular Finding Value Set
Description: Qualitative findings recorded at a gaze position: sensory responses on the red filter plus light and Worth 4 dot tests (fusion, suppression of one eye, crossed or uncrossed diplopia) and the position of the corneal light reflex on the Hirschberg test (centered, or displaced nasally, temporally, superiorly or inferiorly in the eye assessed). The binding is extensible, so other findings (e.g. tropia vs phoria on a prism cover test) may be used when no concept here applies.

Name: GazePositionVS
Title: Gaze Position Value Set
Description: The nine diagnostic positions of gaze at which a strabismus measurement or binocular finding is recorded: primary position, the four secondary positions (up gaze / supraversion, down gaze / infraversion, right gaze / dextroversion, left gaze / levoversion) and the four tertiary (oblique) positions. SNOMED CT qualifier values from the Gaze directions hierarchy.

Name: HorizontalDeviationDirectionVS
Title: Horizontal Deviation Direction Value Set
Description: Direction of a horizontal ocular deviation at a gaze position: esodeviation, exodeviation, or orthophoria when no horizontal deviation is present. Covers both tropias and phorias; the magnitude is recorded separately as a positive value.

Name: LowVisionAssessmentVS
Title: Low Vision Assessment Value Set
Description: Qualitative visual acuity for patients whose vision falls below what any chart can measure (ICD-11 blindness categories 4 through 6). All five codes are confirmed SNOMED CT concepts, verified directly against the SNOMED CT browser. See Terminology for the full clinical and terminology rationale. The counting-fingers concept below uses the generic code by default; the more specific distance-based codes may be used instead when that detail is known.

Name: NormativeClassificationVS
Title: Normative Classification Value Set
Description: Classification of an ophthalmic measurement or analysis against the device normative (age-matched reference) database: within normal limits, borderline, or outside normal limits. Used for the overall interpretation of OCT macula and OCT RNFL / optic nerve head analyses, and for the per-subfield deviation category of the OCT macula profile. Bindings are extensible, so device-specific percentile categories (e.g. p<5%, p<1%) may be used when no concept here applies.

Name: OphthalmicCarePlanCategoryVS
Title: Ophthalmic Care Plan Category Value Set
Description: The type of ophthalmic treatment scheme. Proposed FHIR4Eyes-only codes, open to revision if a suitable external code is identified later.

Name: TestDistanceCategoryVS
Title: Test Distance Category Value Set
Description: Categorical testing distance of a strabismus or binocular vision test: near (about 33-40 cm) or far (about 6 m / 20 ft). The binding is extensible, so other categories (e.g. intermediate) may be used when needed.

Name: VerticalDeviationDirectionVS
Title: Vertical Deviation Direction Value Set
Description: Direction of a vertical ocular deviation of the deviating eye at a gaze position: hyperdeviation or hypodeviation. Covers both tropias and phorias; the magnitude is recorded separately as a positive value.
